g.desc: Process JRN-001: Initiate payment (Journey step). It Accept a traceable payment instruction; hands Screen the instruction “Screen”. 21 more in Process hands it “2 relationships”; Logical application realizes it.

Process JRN-002: Screen the instruction (Journey step). It Hold an instruction that needs review; hands 21 more in Process “Disposition”. Initiate payment hands it “Screen”; Logical application realizes it.

Process JRN-003: Record the posting (Journey step). It Prevent duplicate financial effects; hands Settle the payment “Submit once”. 21 more in Process hands it “Allow”; Logical application realizes it.

Process JRN-004: Settle the payment (Journey step). It Retain an uncertain settlement outcome; hands 21 more in Process “Resolve”. Record the posting hands it “Submit once”; Logical application realizes it.
